title: Director, Foundations
description: <h2>Opportunity  </h2> <p>As a Director, you will lead on the development and delivery of strategic communications plans and provide senior-level advice to a broad range of clients in the foundations and non-profit sector. You will develop and land regular and proactive ideas for clients, advising on critical issues impacting some of the world’s most influential businesses and playing a leading role as day-to-day point of contact for your clients.</p> <p>You will also develop strategies to approach and cultivate new business targets using a strong internal network that includes talent from across Brunswick’s entire offering, as well as your own external network.</p> <p>You will ensure the smooth running of teams by establishing clear roles, managing performance, and ensuring that all key stakeholders and client needs are being covered by the team. You will work closely with Partners on all aspects of client management, including account finances, fee negotiation, and adviser meetings.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <ul> <li>Significantly contribute to the development and enhancement of Brunswick’s Foundations and Non-Profits practice in the UK, Europe, Africa, and globally; by deepening our expertise and building a world-class practice that will deliver outstanding work.</li> <li>Understand and articulate the issues and challenges facing philanthropy; working with clients and colleagues to translate these issues into meaningful programmes which align with and ultimately enhance the respective client’s wider business strategy.</li> <li>Build trusted relationships with clients; partnering with them and helping them define and articulate their position across a range of audiences and stakeholder groups.</li> <li>Drive at least one major global client account</li> <li>Foster ‘big idea’ generation, innovation and activation across the sector, driving colleagues and teams to bring ideas to life.</li> <li>Drive new business and prospecting; work closely with Brunswick colleagues to define and deliver a business strategy which makes use of internal networks and marketing opportunities to deliver “more for more”.</li> <li>Maintain clear sight of the operational effectiveness of client accounts and teams, staying close on quality assurance and open to being “hands-on” with client work.</li> <li>Lead by example to move the business forward and to support the ongoing development of colleagues and mentees. Inspire, develop, and actively mentor colleagues.</li> <li>Proactively represent Brunswick’s Foundations and Non-Profits practice externally, and alongside other key colleagues within the Partnership.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <h2>What We're Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>A strong track record either working in an advisory role within a global corporate or charitable foundation, multilateral organisation, NGO, or government or consulting experience advising philanthropic clients. Agency experience is preferred and advantageous.</li> <li>10+ years’ relevant professional experience.</li> <li>Deep understanding of the philanthropic and international development landscape, with first-hand experience of handling highly topical issues, and an extensive network from which to draw intelligence.</li> <li>An understanding of the interplay between business, politics, and society, particularly as it relates to this sector.</li> <li>A strong understanding of corporate positioning, and how to develop strategies and advocacy campaigns that can translate into programs with real sustained impact.</li> <li>Ability to operate effectively in a commercial, self-starting, and fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Experience advising senior leaders with efficacy and diplomacy.</li> <li>Ability to connect with and leverage the skills and expertise of colleagues, to deliver the best possible advice, campaigns and programs to clients.</li> <li>A strong verbal and written communicator with high EQ levels and an engaging presentation style.</li> <li>A global perspective and experience working with international teams or organisations.</li> <li>A balance of creative and analytical thinking, bringing rigor, accuracy, and attention to detail.</li> <li>A natural team-worker who prefers to work in a collegiate way.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <p>Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of exceptional employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1>About Brunswick</h1> <p>Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. </p> <p>Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.</p> <p>Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. title: CASS Oversight Manager (f/m/d)
description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive . Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. About the role: As the CASS Oversight Manager, you are responsible for ensuring that client money and custody assets held by Upvest Securities are protected, segregated and accounted for in full compliance with the FCA’s Client Assets Sourcebook (CASS). You will act as the primary day-to-day authority on CASS, bridging the gap between complex regulatory requirements, our operational processes, our client’s needs and our scalable investment API. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Client and Operations teams to ensure our client asset framework remains robust, evidenced and audit-ready, enabling Upvest to scale its financial infrastructure to millions of end-users while maintaining the highest levels of integrity and trust with regulators, clients, and partners. What you’ll do: Own the CASS oversight framework: Maintain and continuously improve Upvest's CASS risk assessment, controls matrix, policies and procedures across CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, providing clear guidance to the business on what is and isn't permitted. Work with our B2B clients, sales and client impact teams to actively shape solutions and provide advice that enables Upvest to support engaging and accessible investing for millions of end users in a CASS compliant way. Oversee reconciliations and client money calculations: Oversee daily client money calculations and internal and external reconciliations of client money and custody assets, ensuring breaks are investigated promptly, shortfalls are funded and root causes are addressed. Manage breaches and regulatory reporting: Maintain the CASS breach register, assess materiality, drive remediation and support FCA notifications where required. Own the monthly CMAR submission and act as the primary contact for the annual CASS audit, closing out findings to completion. Keep the CASS Resolution Pack live: Ensure the resolution pack is complete, current and retrievable within regulatory timeframes, and that it is updated whenever banks, custodians, key vendors or critical staff change. Embed CASS into how we build: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess the client asset impact of new products, features and system changes, and to ensure our ledgers, payment flows and custody integrations do what the rules require by design. Enhance governance and culture: Produce clear CASS MI for the board and risk committees, deliver CASS training across the organisation, and track FCA developments to assess their impact on Upvest. Manage external relationships: Support due diligence and periodic reviews of banks, custodians, and maintain acknowledgement letters and mandate registers in the prescribed form. Feed into TISA and other appropriate forums to gain further industry insights. What you bring: Deep CASS Expertise: Thorough working knowledge of CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, including client money calculations, reconciliation methods, acknowledgement letters, resolution pack requirements and the SMCR context in which the SMF18 operates. Hands-on Client Asset Experience: Several years in a CASS operations, oversight or audit role in practice or at a broker, platform, custodian or wealth manager, with practical experience of breach handling, CMAR reporting and CASS audits. Regulatory Analysis Skills: Proven experience in interpreting FCA rules and guidance and translating them into clear actionable operational procedures and controls. Stakeholder Management: Strong communication of regulatory requirements to internal and external stakeholders, including engineering and product teams, external auditors and third-party custodians and banks. Self-Starter Mentality: A highly organised approach with the ability to work independently, prioritise appropriately, and thrive under pressure, particularly around reporting and audit deadlines. It’s great if you have: Qualifications: Relevant industry certifications such as CISI Client Assets Specialist qualification, an accounting or audit background, or equivalent professional certification in a related discipline. How we Upvest in you: Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market. Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits. Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest. Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it. Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose. Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program. Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements. Inclusion : We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies. Our Values: Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions. Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection. Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together. Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others. Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
description: About Codat Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work. Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time. The Role We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it. This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you. What You'll Work On The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona. The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this. The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one. The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work. Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one. You'll Probably Have Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready. Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy. Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them. Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them. Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server. Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team. An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too. Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same. How We Work We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish. title: FPGA Firmware Engineer
description: About Singular Photonics: Singular Photonics is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor start-up, developing Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) sensors that bring advanced computation directly into imaging. Our sensors enable innovations across LiDAR, fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), spectroscopy and time-resolved optical measurements, powering next-generation solutions for customers worldwide. Based at Orchard Brae House in Edinburgh, we are a close-knit team at the forefront of the photonics revolution. About the Role: We are seeking an FPGA Firmware Engineer to join our multidisciplinary R&D team. This is an FPGA role: you will design, implement and verify the Verilog firmware that powers our SPAD sensors, captures photon timing data at high rates and streams it to the host. Our sensors generate data faster than most imaging systems ever see, so the interesting problems here are real ones: clock domain crossing, timing closure and getting data off the device without losing a photon. You will work alongside our hardware, ASIC and software engineers, from architecture through to system bring-up and customer deployment. You will report to the Lead Firmware Engineer. Key Responsibilities: Architecture: Define FPGA requirements and architecture for SPAD sensor readout, in discussion with the hardware, ASIC and software teams. RTL Design: Implement, verify and debug Verilog modules for data acquisition, photon timing, histogramming and sensor control. Verification: Design and run simulations and testbenches, with coverage sufficient to trust the design before it reaches hardware. Synthesis & Timing: Own synthesis, constraints, clock domain crossing and timing closure on AMD-Xilinx FPGA family devices in Vivado. High-Speed Interfaces: Build and integrate the high-speed interfaces that move sensor data: PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, AXI interface, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS, Camera Link. Bring-Up & Debug: Lead firmware bring-up on new boards and sensors, debugging with oscilloscopes, logic analysers and in-system probes. Source Control & Build: Keep RTL under version control with a repeatable, automated build, and document designs to the standard our ISO 9001 design control process requires. Reviews & Support: Contribute to design reviews, and support the software team and customers during field integration. Experience & Skills: Essential: Strong proficiency in Verilog, and a solid grounding in RTL design, synthesis and timing closure. Hands-on experience with AMD-Xilinx Vivado and its toolchain. Experience writing your own testbenches and verifying a design in simulation before hardware. Experience bringing up firmware on real hardware and debugging it in the lab. Experience with at least one high-speed interface or bus at RTL level. Comfortable in a small company where priorities shift and everyone pitches in. Working with complex, existing codebases and seamlessly integrating new functionality with minimal disruption. Desirable: SystemVerilog, and verification practices beyond directed testbenches. Comfortable working in Linux operating systems. Exposure to any of PCIe, AXI interface, USB3, Ethernet, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS or Camera Link. C, C++ or Python for embedded software integration and test automation. Experience with image sensors, time-of-flight, TDCs or single-photon detection. Familiarity with PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, and reading schematics during debug. Educational Background: Degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 2-5 years' experience in FPGA and digital design. Key Attributes & Behaviours: Rigour: Disciplined about verification - you would rather find it in simulation than on the bench. Debugging: Systematic when the fault could be in the RTL, the board or the sensor, and comfortable with the instruments that tell you which. Clarity: Writes documentation and code that colleagues can pick up without you in the room. Collaboration: Works well across the hardware, ASIC and software boundaries rather than only inside the FPGA. Ownership: Takes a problem from architecture through to a working system, and sees it through. Adaptability: Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment where the requirement can move. Success Indicators: Firmware that meets timing and functions correctly on first hardware more often than not, with issues found in simulation rather than on the bench. Effective bring-up and debugging support during prototype validation and customer deployment, with hardware and firmware issues resolved promptly. Design documentation, simulation coverage and design review contributions good enough for another engineer to maintain the work. Benefits of Joining Singular Photonics At Singular Photonics, we are committed to fostering a rewarding and supportive environment for our team. As an FPGA Firmware Engineer, you will benefit from: Pension: 5% company contribution. Share Options: Participation in the Company EMI Share Option Scheme, so you share in the growth you help build. Enhanced Annual Leave: 35 days paid annual leave per year, inclusive of UK public holidays. Hybrid Working: Primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week (full time worker). Career Growth: Work on silicon and systems few engineers get near, with the chance to shape how we do FPGA development as the team grows. Additional Benefits: [Cycle to work and private medical insurance (once implemented) Why Join Us This position offers a rare opportunity to work at the forefront of SPAD sensor technology, driving innovation and shaping future applications in photonics and imaging. At Singular Photonics you will be part of a passionate, close-knit team, where the work you do is visible in the product and in the hands of customers. Location & Work Environment Based at Orchard Brae House, Queensferry Road, Edinburgh. This is a full-time, permanent role. The work is hands-on with hardware in our lab, so it is primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week. Right to work in the UK is essential. We are unfortunately unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Equal Opportunities Singular Photonics is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make appointments on merit, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need any adjustments to the application or interview process, please let us know and we will do what we can to accommodate you. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. <strong>Please note: </strong>This position requires verbal and written fluency in German.</div> <div><br><strong>The Role:</strong><br>As an <strong>Account Specialist</strong>, you will provide white glove service to diverse brands investing in influencer marketing campaigns. This role is particularly focused on campaign execution, including but not limited to driving influencer recruitment, managing influencer partnerships, and owning campaign deliverables, tracking, and reporting. The Account Specialist will also drive strategy by analyzing campaign performance, identifying success areas and/or challenge areas, and proactively implementing strategic measures to continuously optimize programs towards goals and objectives.<br>The successful candidate will have strong experience in developing and managing successful, KPI-driven influencer marketing campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies. They will have working knowledge of the overall partner marketing landscape, including affiliate, and the ability to both develop comprehensive strategy as well as capably execute. The successful candidate will be a self-starter that can confidently plug in to any challenging situation with ease and can balance competing priorities well. The Account Specialist must be flexible, willing and able to pivot quickly, and excited to operate successfully in an “intrapreneurial” situation. This person will also have a history of working well with their peers, quickly establishing relationships easily and leading through influence.</div> <div><br>You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth.</div> <div><br><strong>Top 5 Responsibilities:</strong></div> <ul> <li><strong>INFLUENCER RECRUITMENT, NEGOTIATING & ONBOARDING –</strong>Sources new partnership opportunities and creates influencer casting lists. Diligently vets opportunities to ensure brand alignment, authenticity and relevancy prior to presenting to client for approval. Conducts outreach to approved partners and skillfully garners their engagement and participation in the campaign, negotiating when necessary. Supports influencers through campaign onboarding by developing and providing resources to streamline processes.</li> <li><strong>INFLUENCER PARTNERSHIPS MANAGEMENT </strong>– Crafts program-wide influencer communications and vital creator resources. Guides influencers on content strategy and creation. Works with influencers to develop content timelines and ensures influencers stay on track with the schedules discussed. Collects content drafts and leads the content review process, including screening to ensure FTC guidelines are met. Closely works with influencers to adjust content strategy as needed, troubleshooting any signs of poor performance to optimize campaign towards goals and objectives.</li> <li><strong>AUDITING, REPORTING & ANALYSIS </strong>– Accountable for auditing program content to ensure compliance with FTC regulations and brand guidelines. Ensures content is tracked accurately and regularly shared with client, along with placement insights, partner insights, and campaign pace towards KPI goals. Performs robust analysis of influencer campaigns using both social analytics and conversion metrics to identify performance trends and areas of opportunity. Proactively provides actionable recommendations to client backed by data and continuously refines strategy to drive growth at scale. Supports team in creation of customized strategy plans, detailed campaign performance summaries and comprehensive hindsight presentations that are delivered to clients.</li> <li><strong>CLIENT SERVICE & COMMUNICATION</strong>- Consistently provides superior client service and escalates issues or key risks as appropriate. Works to ensure client develops trust in our team by delivering client outputs and communications in the AP way, consistently maintaining quality, accuracy, and precision. Develops and nurtures excellent relationships, supports team in promoting very high client satisfaction and retention rates, and an average 8.5 client rating.</li> <li><strong>PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT</strong>- Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Manages multiple campaigns with solid organizational skills and the ability to focus on and prioritize tasks based on client objectives, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Has full grasp of each client’s scope of work, delivering what is due under terms; maintains ability to identify new opportunities to drive client success while conjunctively identifying possible goal misalignments, getting to the root of an issue, and working with their team to bring solutions to resolve.</li> </ul> <div><br><strong>What Success Looks Like:</strong><br><strong>BY 3 MONTHS:</strong></div> <ul> <li>The Account Specialist is contributing across a portfolio of influencer programs, collaborating with their team closely to ensure strong alignment with the campaign strategy in place.</li> <li>You are working with key client contacts to ensure brand alignment with recruitment efforts and content creation.</li> <li>You have become familiar with AP’s tools and solutions and are equipped to conduct casting for prospective influencers, execute content timelines with influencers, audit content, and ensure performance is tracked and measured.</li> </ul> <div><strong>By 6 MONTHS:</strong></div> <ul> <li>You are owning execution of the day-to-day operations of multiple influencer programs with little guidance from your team, including reporting, processing applications, recruiting and casting creators, and crafting partner communications.</li> <li>Challenging client or team situations are being managed with guidance from managers and directors collaborating closely to bring a solutions-oriented approach to these situations proactively.</li> <li>You are regularly analyzing client data and strategically leveraging insights to optimize campaigns.</li> <li>Client accounts are being handled effectively and strategically, without dropping any balls, and clients are aware of and pleased with this outcome. Clients are being serviced profitably with AP targets, client KPI’s being met, and an average 8.5 client rating is being upheld across campaigns.</li> <li>You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance</li> </ul> <div><strong>By 1 YEAR:</strong></div> <ul> <li>You will troubleshoot and resolve account and creator issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.</li> <li>You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.</li> <li>You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Qualities of the Ideal Candidate</strong></div> <ul> <li>Has a strong internal motivation to get the job done and done well</li> title: Head of Product Design
description: <div class="description content"> <p><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/">Thoughtworks</a> is a global technology consultancy that integrates design, engineering and AI to drive digital innovation. We are over 10,000 people strong across 47 offices in 18 countries. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology and culture as the differentiator.<br><br>Thoughtworks.com is one of our most important customer-facing products, helping clients discover our expertise, explore evidence of our impact and take the next step with us. It also helps job seekers explore opportunities and gives search engines and AI assistants an accurate, trusted understanding of who we are and what we do.</p> <p>Today, fragmented ownership across Marketing limits our ability to deliver connected customer journeys, maintain consistent quality and continuously improve performance.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Head of Product Design to change that. You’ll lead Thoughtworks.com as a digital product, translating our go-to-market and employer brand strategies into seamless experiences for customers, job seekers and AI agents. You’ll own the website strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, publishing model and content and design quality. You'll also shape experiences across connected channels, including email through Knak and events through Splash, while influencing the internal workflows that drive quality, consistency and speed.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, player-coach role for someone who can think strategically and deliver at every level, from defining roadmaps and improving customer journeys to refining copy, reviewing designs, interpreting performance data and making launch decisions.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li> <h3>Website product strategy</h3> <ul> <li>Set the product vision, principles and roadmap for Thoughtworks.com</li> <li>Prioritize work around customer and business outcomes rather than requests for individual pages</li> <li>Connect the website roadmap to Thoughtworks’ go-to-market priorities, propositions and major company launches.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Customer journeys and experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build a deep understanding of our audiences, including enterprise buyers, technology leaders, practitioners, partners, prospective employees and alumni community</li> <li>Design connected journeys that help people move from a question/problem/need to relevant services, expertise, evidence and action, where the site fuels journeys on AI platforms that might never have users interact with our site</li> <li>Use customer research, website data and market insight to identify friction and opportunities</li> <li>Ensure the core website, event pages and email experiences work together where they form part of the same journey.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Narrative, copy and content quality</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the quality and coherence of the website narrative, copy and information architecture</li> <li>Translate complex technology services and Thoughtworks expertise into clear, credible experiences for different audiences</li> <li>Challenge unclear propositions, duplicated content, unsupported claims and pages that do not serve a defined customer need</li> <li>Work with the central Content team, service-line marketers and subject-matter experts, while keeping accountability for how content works within the overall experience</li> <li>Work with content operations to establish reusable content patterns, editorial standards and clear ownership for maintaining important content.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Experiences for people and agents</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Ensure the website is useful and understandable to human visitors, search engines and AI assistants</li> <li>Partner with the SEO and LLM Discoverability Lead to improve how Thoughtworks is found, interpreted and represented to support buyers in their decision making process</li> <li>Shape requirements for structured content, metadata, evidence, content relationships and reusable information</li> <li>Balance machine readability with strong human storytelling, accessibility and brand expression.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Publishing model for the AI era</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the spec for redesigning the publishing workflow from brief through design, production, approval, release and ongoing improvement</li> <li>Work with the GTM tech and Global IT teams to replace manual, error-prone production with reusable patterns, clearer decision rights and proportionate automation</li> <li>Identify where AI can improve research, prototyping, content preparation, metadata, accessibility checks, quality assurance and content maintenance</li> <li>Turn good judgment into practical standards, templates, playbooks and automated checks</li> <li>Build a model that allows teams to move faster without lowering the quality bar or creating uncontrolled publishing.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Design quality and experimentation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Set the direction and quality bar for UX, UI, interaction design and the website design system</li> <li>Use qualitative and quantitative evidence to improve journeys, messaging and conversion over time</li> <li>Sign off on experience quality before major launches.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Team and agency leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning product design, experience production, transformation and discoverability</li> <li>Give people clear outcomes, decision rights, constructive feedback and room to do excellent work</li> <li>Build an effective working model with the central Content team, GTM technology, Global IT and service-line marketers.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>10 - 15 years experience leading digital products, customer experiences, service design or product design</li> <li>A strong record of turning customer insight and business strategy into coherent end-to-end experiences</li> <li>Excellent judgment across product, UX, content and design, with the ability to recognize and explain what good looks like</li> <li>Strong writing and editorial instincts, including the confidence to simplify complex ideas and challenge unclear copy</li> <li>Experience working with marketing, product, design, engineering and senior business stakeholders</li> <li>Commercial understanding and the ability to connect digital experience decisions to go-to-market outcomes</li> <li>Systems thinking, including experience creating reusable patterns, design systems, operating models or publishing frameworks</li> <li>Practical understanding of search, structured content and how AI assistants discover and interpret information</li> <li>Experience using AI tools to improve how work is researched, designed, produced or assured</li> <li>The ability to operate in ambiguity, make difficult prioritization decisions and move from strategy to delivery</li> <li>Evidence of leading and coaching people or multidisciplinary teams.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>You have a natural ability to establish and nurture relationships with senior leaders across the organization</li> <li>You have excellent context-switching capabilities</li> <li>You thrive in situations where you are given little to no direction and have the ability to lead, organize and deliver commitments on time and within budget</li> <li>You’re resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives. You don’t shy away from risks, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them</li> <li>You’re empathetic and use this ability to build solid working relationships and resolve issues quickly and thoughtfully</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning & Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.</p> </div> <p style="display: none;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Systems Engineer - Commissioning and Characterisation
description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Explore how a next-generation AI architecture behaves from rack scale to data centre scale. </p> <p>As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will investigate a novel AI computing architecture under demanding real-world workloads. You will work on problems where answers aren't readily known, turning curiosity into measurable evidence.</p> <p>You will design experiments, benchmark representative AI workloads and explore how hardware components and software interact at scale. When behaviour is unexpected, you will turn this into new measurements.</p> <p>Your work will help infrastructure engineers, architects and application specialists understand system behaviour, performance, scalability and reliability across the stack. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics.</p> <p>You do not need to be an AI expert. You will need strong judgement, curiosity and a clear preference for evidence over opinion. You will love this role if you are someone who takes initiative, questions assumptions and enjoys working in areas where the answers are not yet known.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>The System QA team is distributed across multiple locations. We work hard to stay connected and collaborate closely. Our daily team meetings feel more like a virtual coffee break than a formal status update with space to share ideas, ask questions, discuss discoveries and solve problems together.</p> <p>We value trust, autonomy and openness, and we understand that great engineers don't all follow the same career path. What matters is the quality of your work, your curiosity, and your willingness to explore challenging problems.</p> <p>You will have regular 1:1s with your people manager where you will have the opportunity to discuss things that matter to you. You will have dedicated time each week to focus on your CPD. The technical lead will provide direction and help set priorities, but everyone in the team is there to support each other.</p> <p>One of our core principles is that we measure and report what we observe without trying to make results look better or worse than they are.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>Comfortable using Python to write tests, automate tasks, analyse data or develop practical engineering tools.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>A curiosity-driven approach to investigating complex systems.</li> <li>Ability to explain technical findings clearly, using accurate and reproducible evidence.</li> <li>Confidence to work independently, take responsibility and collaborate across engineering teams.</li> <li>Experience in some of the following would be valuable: AI workloads and benchmarking, systems architecture, parallel and distributed computing, automation, containers or modern orchestration infrastructure</li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences from different industries. We actively welcome applications from engineers to the profession through a returnship or after a career break.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</li> <li>Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work</li> <li>Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension</li> <li>Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success</li> <li>Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day</li> <li>Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones</li> <li>Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover</li> <li>Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating.</strong></p> <p>Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Backed by a $200M investment led by General Atlantic, we became the first product of our kind to reach a $1B valuation in 2024 – and we’re not slowing down.</p> <p>With 7M paid subscribers and the highest-rated experience in the App Store’s health category, we’ve spent 10 years earning trust at scale. Now, we’re building the next generation of digital health – AI-powered, privacy-first, clinically backed – to help our users know their body better.</p> <p><strong>The job</strong></p></div><h1><strong>Principal Infrastructure Engineer</strong></h1> <p>More than 80 million women open Flo every month to understand their bodies and their health. Every one of those sessions runs on infrastructure we build, and the data behind it is as personal as data gets. Keeping that fast and private at this scale is the job.</p> <p>Velocity runs the platform that every Flo engineer builds on: Kubernetes on AWS, the data stores behind our services, and the golden paths that let product teams ship without needing to be infrastructure experts. We treat our internal developers as our customers. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own the foundations:</strong> Design and run the Kubernetes and data infrastructure behind 80 million monthly active users, and make it boring in the best sense.</li> <li><strong>Turn expertise into self-service:</strong> Take what you know about running clusters and databases well, and build it into the defaults so product teams get it for free.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You Will Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Kubernetes at scale:</strong> Architect and evolve our EKS estate: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, networking, autoscaling, workload isolation, and the Helm and Terraform that deploy onto it.</li> <li><strong>Data infrastructure:</strong> Shape how our services use PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Kafka. Set the patterns for provisioning, access, backup, failover and capacity, so teams aren't solving these problems one service at a time.</li> <li><strong>Golden paths:</strong> Build self-service tooling and Terraform modules that give product teams autonomy without sacrificing stability or security.</li> <li><strong>Reliability:</strong> Lead resilience work, including business continuity planning, disaster recovery testing and a sustainable on-call rotation.</li> <li><strong>Privacy at scale:</strong> Support the infrastructure behind privacy features such as our TIME-recognised "Anonymous Mode", and keep us SOC2, ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified while handling some of the most sensitive data there is.</li> <li><strong>Observability:</strong> Make sure metrics, logs and traces tell us something is wrong before our users do.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Many years in infrastructure, platform, SRE or DevOps roles running high-traffic, distributed systems in production. You have operated at Principal or Staff scope, setting direction across teams as well as delivering.</li> <li><strong>Kubernetes depth:</strong> You have run Kubernetes in production for real workloads, ideally EKS. You can explain what happens between kubectl apply and a pod serving traffic, and you have debugged it when it didn't.</li> <li><strong>Data infrastructure awareness:</strong> You understand how PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Kafka behave under load and when they fail: connection limits, replication lag, hot partitions, consumer lag, retention. You don't need to have been a DBA, but you know what good looks like and when to ask for help.</li> <li><strong>AWS and infrastructure as code:</strong> Strong AWS knowledge and fluent Terraform. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.</p> <h4>About Kaluza</h4> <p>Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.</p> <p>With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.</p> <h4>What you’ll do</h4> <p>Hands-on research</p> <ul> <li>Run mixed-methods research in a B2B2C setting, combining qualitative studies with behavioural data in Mixpanel, that sets the standard for good research and shapes team roadmaps and client conversations</li> <li>Research the whole chain, from client teams and subject matter experts to their end customers and the developers using our SDKs and APIs, and look for patterns that hold across clients so we build once and reuse</li> <li>Make sure research has impact: track whether it changed a decision and what result followed, and use that to make the case for research investment</li> </ul> <p>Research enablement and operations</p> <ul> <li>Democratise research: coach and mentor colleagues in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own studies with rigour, through workshops, guidance and lightweight methods</li> <li>Make insight easy to find and trust, through our insights agents, knowledge bases and journey management artefacts, backed by data you can rely on (quality, privacy, bias), so people can find and question evidence themselves</li> <li>Help run research operations: improve how we recruit participants (frameworks, lead times, consent and data protection), and set clear guardrails so teams run ethical, compliant research</li> <li>Assess and recommend research tools, deciding when to build and when to buy, trial them, and support procurement; use AI-assisted development such as Claude Code to build working tools where that is the right call</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring <br></strong><br>Ideally you’ll have/be</p> <ul> <li>A track record of running research end to end that other teams used in product or roadmap decisions, with strong data literacy: you combine qualitative methods with behavioural data and know what the numbers can and can’t tell us</li> <li>Experience researching in B2B or B2B2C or enterprise contexts, including technical users such as developers (eg SDKs, APIs or documentation), or a strong appetite to learn how</li> <li>Experience coaching non-researchers in research fundamentals (interviewing, bias mitigation, ethical handling of user data) so they can self-serve</li> <li>Experience on a platform or multi-client product, spotting patterns across customers, and familiarity with journey mapping or service design methods</li> <li>Experience in research operations or enablement, such as participant recruitment, consent and data governance, repositories or tool selection, with judgement on when to build and when to buy</li> <li>Confidence working with some autonomy across a distributed, international team</li> </ul> <p><strong>What will set you apart</strong> </p> <ul> <li>You’ve built a tool, repository or pipeline that measurably cut the time from research signal to team-wide insight</li> <li>You’ve found a way to measure developer experience where there was no playbook (eg time to first successful call, or where developers drop off)</li> <li>You’ve made the case for research with real numbers, and followed your research after the readout to see what happened</li> </ul> <p><strong>Where you'll work<br></strong>We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.</p> <h4><strong>Our Values<br></strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Play to win:</strong> Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.</li> <li><strong>Solve the real problem:</strong> Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Build trust every day:</strong> Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.</li> <li><strong>Own the outcome:</strong> Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.</li> <li><strong>Go further together: </strong>Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Our Perks</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Time off and family:</strong> 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period</li> <li><strong>Health and security:</strong> Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests</li> <li><strong>Pay and flexibility:</strong> Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work</li> <li><strong>Growth and setup:</strong> Personal learning budget, home office budget</li> <li><strong>Climate:</strong> Furthr, our climate action app</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Come as you are</strong></h4> <p>We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.</p> <p>Find out more on our<a href="https://www.kaluza.com/careers/"> careers page</a> and<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/kaluza/"> LinkedIn</a>. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is<a href="https://www.kaluza.com/applicant-data-protection-notice/"> here</a>.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Infrastructure Manager
description: Who We Are At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. The Role We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader. In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed. The Team You Will Lead You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms. You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in: On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments. Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused. Cloud environments: GCP and AWS Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD) The Operational Reality It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources. Context Switching is the Norm You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve. Agility over Silos Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum. Focus Management Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time. As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will: People Leadership & Talent Development Team Management Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management. Formal Training & Growth Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports. Recruitment & Retention Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture. Culture of Learning Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference. Strategic & Operational Management Budget & Capacity Planning Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware. Risk & Contingency Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity. Procedure & Frameworks Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards. Prioritisation Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations. Technical Support & Oversight Performance Optimisation Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them. Visual Documentation Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor. Hybrid Estate Management Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments. Unblocking Issues Act as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues. Your goal is not to fix the issue yourself, but to coordinate the right resources and provide air cover. General Duties On-Call DutiesWillingness to participate in the Management On-Call Rotation to support the department and the business (Current frequency: Once every three weeks). Ad-HocCarry out other strategic or technical duties required to support the Director/VP of Technical Operations. Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Leadership & Management Competencies Proven Management Experience Significant experience leading a technical team, with a specific focus on the people management aspect (performance reviews, career growth etc). Project Management Strong project management experience with the ability to delegate effectively to meet tight deadlines. You must be able to multitask and maintain focus in a high-priority environment. Communication Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to liaise effectively with management and other business areas. Engagement may also include interactions with senior technical engineers/leaders within other teams and C-Team members. Goal Oriented You must be highly goal-oriented with strict attention to detail, capable of prioritising workload and demand to ensure targets are met. ITIL Application / Lean Six Sigma Deep knowledge of and experience with ITIL practices, with the ability to apply them to improve team workflows. Demonstrated ability to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts. Technical Environment & Team Capabilities Focusing on the technical skills that your engineers possess, it would be ideal if you had a decent working knowledge of each of the areas. Hands-on expertise in every area is not required, but the ability to hold and facilitate discussions, know when to push or hold back and when to ask poignant questions will help you effectively mentor the team and guide architectural decisions. For reference from above these areas are: on-prem and AWS/GCP solutions; system design from network to application level; resilient database availability strategies; automation and configuration management via Ansible, Docker and CI/CD; programming awareness in Python; Linux administration. Your willingness to learn what you don't know is required to succeed in this role and we will support you through that journey. Desirable Knowledge, Skills, and Experience The following skills or experiences are advantageous but not strictly required. They would be utilised for facilitating tasks rather than for direct, hands-on implementation. Innovation & Debt Management A keen interest in new technologies and innovation, specifically supporting development teams in the refactoring of technical debt. Advanced Containerization Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container ecosystems. Observability Experience with monitoring systems (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana) and logging stacks (Elasticsearch, Kibana). Data Streaming Experience with data streaming and queuing technologies, specifically Apache Kafka and Druid. Web & Storage Knowledge of Nginx (or other web server technologies) and storage technologies like Gluster. Tooling Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation. Version Control strong understanding of Git and version control best practices. Why This Role? If you are an experienced technical leader who finds more satisfaction in growing people and building high-performing teams than in closing tickets yourself, this is the role for you. You will have the autonomy to shape the culture of the Infrastructure function and the strategic backing to make a real impact on the business This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role. UK Benefits & Perks 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year Private Medical Insurance through Vitality Enhanced pension contributions Cycle to Work scheme Eye Care Vouchers Life Assurance Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program Regular company events and activities Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception. Privacy and data protection . The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms. You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in: On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments. Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused. Cloud environments: GCP and AWS Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD) The Operational Reality It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources. Context Switching is the Norm You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve. Agility over Silos Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum. Focus Management Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time. As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will: People Leadership & Talent Development Team Management Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management. Formal Training & Growth Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports. Recruitment & Retention Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture. Culture of Learning Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference. Strategic & Operational Management Budget & Capacity Planning Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware. Risk & Contingency Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity. Procedure & Frameworks Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards. Prioritisation Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations. Technical Support & Oversight Performance Optimisation Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them. Visual Documentation Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor. Hybrid Estate Management Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments. Unblocking Issues Act as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues. Your goal is not to fix the issue yourself, but to coordinate the right resources and provide air cover. General Duties On-Call DutiesWillingness to participate in the Management On-Call Rotation to support the department and the business (Current frequency: Once every three weeks). Ad-HocCarry out other strategic or technical duties required to support the Director/VP of Technical Operations. Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Leadership & Management Competencies Proven Management Experience Significant experience leading a technical team, with a specific focus on the people management aspect (performance reviews, career growth etc). Project Management Strong project management experience with the ability to delegate effectively to meet tight deadlines. You must be able to multitask and maintain focus in a high-priority environment. Communication Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to liaise effectively with management and other business areas. Engagement may also include interactions with senior technical engineers/leaders within other teams and C-Team members. Goal Oriented You must be highly goal-oriented with strict attention to detail, capable of prioritising workload and demand to ensure targets are met. ITIL Application / Lean Six Sigma Deep knowledge of and experience with ITIL practices, with the ability to apply them to improve team workflows. Demonstrated ability to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts. Technical Environment & Team Capabilities Focusing on the technical skills that your engineers possess, it would be ideal if you had a decent working knowledge of each of the areas. Hands-on expertise in every area is not required, but the ability to hold and facilitate discussions, know when to push or hold back and when to ask poignant questions will help you effectively mentor the team and guide architectural decisions. For reference from above these areas are: on-prem and AWS/GCP solutions; system design from network to application level; resilient database availability strategies; automation and configuration management via Ansible, Docker and CI/CD; programming awareness in Python; Linux administration. Your willingness to learn what you don't know is required to succeed in this role and we will support you through that journey. Desirable Knowledge, Skills, and Experience The following skills or experiences are advantageous but not strictly required. They would be utilised for facilitating tasks rather than for direct, hands-on implementation. Innovation & Debt Management A keen interest in new technologies and innovation, specifically supporting development teams in the refactoring of technical debt. Advanced Containerization Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container ecosystems. Observability Experience with monitoring systems (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana) and logging stacks (Elasticsearch, Kibana). Data Streaming Experience with data streaming and queuing technologies, specifically Apache Kafka and Druid. Web & Storage Knowledge of Nginx (or other web server technologies) and storage technologies like Gluster. Tooling Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation. Version Control strong understanding of Git and version control best practices. Why This Role? If you are an experienced technical leader who finds more satisfaction in growing people and building high-performing teams than in closing tickets yourself, this is the role for you. You will have the autonomy to shape the culture of the Infrastructure function and the strategic backing to make a real impact on the business This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role. Experience designing or delivering IAM solutions in cloud, hybrid, or on-premises environments, including deployment, upgrade, resilience, and operational support considerations. Strong diagnostic skills across application, identity, and network layers, with experience using logs and traces to isolate and resolve integration issues. Experience planning and carrying out technical testing, production cutovers, and transition to customer or partner operations. Ability to facilitate technical discovery and design workshops, explain trade-offs clearly, and adapt recommendations to customer constraints and desired outcomes. Experience working within structured delivery practices, including managing technical risks, dependencies, decisions, and changes across a customer engagement. Experience with source control, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and automated testing for repeatable IAM deployments.
