title: Senior Product Engineer
description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Engineering team At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology. Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users. About the role Underwriters at the world's largest insurers still do much of their work in spreadsheets, email threads, and systems that were never designed for the decisions they are making. We are rebuilding that from the ground up. You will join the Workflow Underwriting stream, building the next generation of our underwriting platform. This is not a platform with AI features bolted on. We are designing it around the agents we build, which means the architecture, the domain model, and the interaction patterns are all genuinely open questions. You will help answer them. You will contribute at code, architecture, and domain level from your first weeks, and you will talk directly to the underwriters who use what you build. What you’ll be doing Design, build, and operate backend services in Kotlin or Java, and own them in production. Turn ambiguous underwriting problems into simple, reliable software. Much of the work is deciding what to build, not just building it. Shape architectural decisions: APIs, domain models, persistence, reliability, observability, and how the platform evolves without collapsing under its own weight. Build real depth in the underwriting domain, to the point where you can challenge a requirement rather than only implement it. Design and build agent-assisted workflows, and make judgement calls about where an agent should act, where it should advise, and where a human must stay in control. Use AI coding tools, including Claude, as a core part of how you work. You delegate substantial work to them and you remain accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of everything you ship. Work across boundaries with frontend engineers, product partners, and client-facing teams, and step outside your specialism when the problem demands it. Give and take direct feedback, and raise the engineering bar around you. What you’ll need to have done Strong professional experience building and running backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or another JVM language. Judgement in architecture and system design: a feel for what to build now, what to defer, and what will hurt in two years. Evidence of shipping software that solved a real customer or business problem, ideally something you owned end to end. A self-starting approach. You find the highest-value problem rather than waiting for a ticket. Clear communication. You can hold the same conversation with an underwriter, an executive, and an engineer, and adjust for each. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.</p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strong technical proficiency.</strong> You have at least three years of experience in engineering, specifically within backend-heavy or data-heavy environments.</li> <li><strong>Cloud experience.</strong> You’ve spent time working with cloud-based systems and services and are a strong advocate for TDD and CI/CD.</li> <li><strong>Experience navigating uncertainty.</strong> You’re comfortable taking on ambiguous work with many possible implementation options and identifying the one that pragmatically balances quality and immediate customer value.</li> <li><strong>A collaborative, team-first mindset.</strong> You understand that building great software is a team effort and you’re always willing to pitch in or provide quality feedback in code reviews.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity.</strong> You enjoy picking up new technologies and domains on the job. The idea of working across foundational layers of our stack and multiple products energizes you.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Tech stack knowledge.</strong> Professional background in C#, GraphQL, Elastic, MongoDB and AWS is ideal.</li> <li><strong>Data infrastructure background.</strong> Experience working in environments with significant data scale and complex infrastructure needs.</li> <li><strong>Familiarity with hybrid teams.</strong> You’ve worked with hybrid or remote teams before and can adapt quickly to our international working environment.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role </h2> <ul> <li><strong>Champion work-life harmony</strong>. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.</li> <li><strong>Guarantee autonomy</strong>. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.</li> <li><strong>Encourage career growth. </strong>We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.</li> <li><strong>Provide an environment to help you succeed</strong>. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.</li> <li><strong>Support your wellbeing. </strong>Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The base salary range for this role is displayed below—<strong>starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.</strong></p> <p>We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£51,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£86,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></h2> <p><strong><a href="https://www.hudl.com/jobs/hudl-applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hudl Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy</span></a><br><br></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Warehouse Solution Design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design end-to-end warehouse and fulfilment solutions for complex enterprise customers, from initial concept through to detailed proposals.</li> <li>Develop warehouse layouts, storage strategies, material flows, picking methodologies and operational processes.</li> <li>Evaluate and incorporate automation technologies, including AutoStore, Libiao and Geek+ robotics, based on customer requirements.</li> <li>Assess capacity, throughput, labour requirements and operational constraints to ensure solutions are scalable and deliverable.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Customer Engagement & Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with enterprise customers to understand operational requirements, order profiles, <li>Translate customer needs into clear technical specifications and tailored fulfilment solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Modelling & Commercial Analysis</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop capacity plans, throughput models and operational resource requirements using customer data.</li> <li>Support solution simulations, cost modelling and ROI analysis to demonstrate the benefits of proposed solutions.</li> <li>Work with commercial teams to ensure designs are technically feasible, cost-effective and commercially viable.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Proposals & Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Produce technical solution proposals incorporating warehouse layouts, process flows, automation configurations and supporting financial analysis.</li> <li>Present solutions to customer stakeholders and support tenders, RFPs and complex sales processes.</li> <li>Collaborate with operations, engineering, software and implementation teams to validate designs and ensure successful delivery.</li> <li>Define integration requirements across THG Fulfil’s WMS/WCS/OMS platforms and automated warehouse equipment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Experience Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in warehouse solutions design, logistics engineering, intralogistics, automation engineering or supply chain solutions.</li> <li>Experience designing warehouse or fulfilment solutions for large-scale or complex operations.</li> <li>Strong understanding of warehouse processes, including storage, replenishment, picking, packing, sortation and dispatch.</li> <li>Knowledge of warehouse automation, including robotics, automated storage and retrieval systems, conveyors or goods-to-person solutions.</li> <li>Experience with warehouse layouts, capacity planning, throughput modelling and operational analysis.</li> <li>Commercial awareness, including experience supporting cost models, ROI calculations and customer proposals.</li> <li>Understanding of WMS, WCS and OMS platforms and their integration with warehouse automation.</li> <li>Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to present complex solutions clearly to technical and commercial stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable:</strong> Experience within 3PL, contract logistics or e-commerce fulfilment, with exposure to AutoStore, Libiao, Geek+ or warehouse design and simulation tools.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. title: Associate Solutions Architect
description: <p><strong>About Us:</strong>  </p> <p>We love going to work and think you should too. Our team is dedicated to trust, customer obsession, agility, and striving to be better everyday. These values serve as the foundation of our culture, guiding our actions and driving us towards excellence. We foster a culture of performance and recognition, allowing us to transform growth as we enable our employees to do the best work of their careers.</p> <p><strong>This position is located in London, England. </strong>Our office is situated in a core location near Waterloo and Blackfriars on the Southbank. Across the globe, our Centers of Energy serve as hubs where we accelerate productivity and collaboration, inspire creativity, and cultivate a culture of connection and celebration. Our teams coordinate their time in Centers of Energy to reflect how they work best.</p> <p>To learn more about life at LogicMonitor, check out our <a href="https://www.logicmonitor.com/careers">Careers Page</a>.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p>LogicMonitor® is the AI-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.</p> <p>Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. In fact, LogicMonitor has received the highest Net Promoter Score of any IT Infrastructure Management provider. LogicMonitor also boasts high employee satisfaction. We have been certified as a Great Place To Work®, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row! </p> <div data-hasbody="true" data-macro-name="panel"> <div data-hasbody="true" data-macro-name="panel"> <p>In the professional services team, our mission is to be the trusted partner to the technical teams and strategic partner to the CIO. We aim to deliver a best-in-class observability platform powered by AI. We are committed to providing meaningful metrics that matter, enabling organizations to achieve unparalleled insights, drive innovation, and optimize performance in the dynamic landscape of information technology. We empower teams to optimize performance, enhance client satisfaction, and achieve an unparalleled view of their infrastructure thus allowing the nirvana of being proactive and resolving incidents before they become problems. We help enable insights into not only the infrastructure but also the business and its key value metrics.</p> <p>The Associate Solutions Architect (A.SA) supports the Professional Services (PS) organization in assisting customers to implement the LM Envision platform, extend its capabilities through custom work,  and help drive their business goals by providing a best-in-class service. The A.SA is responsible for working with pre-sales and post-sales teams to scope, design and deploy technical solutions and implementations for LogicMonitor's customers. The A.SA is a product expert that creatively solves business observability problems with LogicMonitor's LM Envision platform.</p> </div> <p><strong>Here's a closer look at this key role:<br></strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Regularly interact with LogicMonitor prospective and existing customers to scope implementations, integrations and custom solutions that meet the customers requirements whilst working within the LM Envision platforms capabilities</p> </li> <li> <p>Technically assess the feasibility and approach for customer monitoring use cases and integrations</p> </li> <li> <p>Explores and researches new technologies to integrate and monitor with LogicMonitor</p> </li> <li> <p>Builds accurate estimates for services proposals, including hours effort, timeframe and pricing</p> </li> <li> <p>Works with Sales, CS  and customers to develop detailed Statements of Work (SOWs) and design documentation</p> </li> <li> <p>Works collaboratively with the other Solutions Architects to peer review services proposals</p> </li> <li> <p>Regularly performs post-sales discovery and design of custom solutions with customers (requirements gathering, researching, prototyping and design documentation)</p> </li> <li> <p>Works collaboratively with the Project Managers and Solutions Architect teams to guide post-sales services delivery, aligning project teams to SOW deliverables, scope of engagement, and technical escalations (where necessary)</p> </li> <li> <p>Assists Solutions Engineer with deployment of tasks and solutions during PS engagements</p> </li> <li> <p>Regularly stays informed on product updates and consult with other SAs on services approach for new LogicMonitor platform features and enhancements</p> </li> <li> <p>Assists in development of new PS offerings and packages in line with customer common requirements and requests</p> </li> <li> <p>Works with product teams where appropriate to raise product issues and provide customer feedback to help drive the product roadmap</p> </li> <li> <p>Participates in product enablement sessions to learn how to best leverage new features and drive new feature enhancements adoption both internally and externally</p> </li> <li> <p>Follows Professional Services best practices</p> </li> <li> <p>Assists in developing and guiding customers on best practices as appropriate to the capabilities of the LM Envision platform<span style="font-size: 8pt; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><br></span></p> </li> </ul> <div><strong>What You'll Need:</strong> <p><strong>Must Have</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>2+ years title: Full-Stack Engineer - Broker Terms Team
description: Full-Stack Engineer - Broker Terms Team Hybrid in London, United Kingdom We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join the Broker Terms team. You’ll build the systems behind every offer iwoca makes through brokers, and see your work in the terms each business gets. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team Broker Terms is a growing team that owns the full offer terms strategy for businesses that come to iwoca through a broker – both first-time and repeat customers. It sets pricing, loan amounts, durations, and broker commissions, and owns the offer user interface (UI) brokers use in the Introducer Portal. The broker network is iwoca's biggest acquisition channel, and the team is directly responsible for the terms that win those customers. The team is small and interdisciplinary – commercial strategy, engineering and data science. It turns business questions into quantitative problems, and findings into timely decisions. It works on short-term gains and longer-term bets, and judges both by Customer Lifetime Value – what a business is worth to iwoca across all its borrowing. There are no fixed office days, and the team meets up for lunch once or twice a month. The role As a full-stack engineer in Broker Terms, you'll make changes across iwoca's codebase wherever they'd improve an offer. Most of it is backend – the code that calculates each offer's terms – with some frontend on the UI where brokers see them. You'll own features and projects from scoping and design through to production, and choose how to build them. You'll help decide what goes on the team's roadmap. You'll learn from the team's experienced engineers, and from the people who price broker offers. The team is light on process – a daily stand-up, a weekly meeting and regular retrospectives – and you'll have a say in how it works. Brokers see your changes in the Introducer Portal, and A/B tests show you which ones raised Customer Lifetime Value. Your work helps businesses get the funding they need. Live project examples: Model-based pricing. Developing the systems that let a model set bespoke pricing for each customer. No-fee test. Testing how the product performs without drawdown fees, and how that changes the way customers repay. Loan durations. Building longer-duration Flexi-Loans with flexible repayments. Offer display. Improving how offers appear to brokers and customers – a better journey, and easier testing for the team's data scientists. Commission systems. Upgrading iwoca's broker commission systems. The requirements Essential: Backend engineering. You've designed and built backend systems that run in production, ideally in Python, Django and PostgreSQL. You've modelled their data with performance and maintenance in mind. Frontend engineering. You've built and maintained user interfaces in production, ideally in TypeScript and React. Ownership. You've taken features end to end, and kept them working once people relied on them. Trade-offs. You've weighed delivery speed against the long-term health of a system, and can explain what you chose and why. AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience. Bonus: DevOps. You've used containers and CI/CD pipelines to deploy your code. Experimentation. You've worked on A/B tests or other experiments, and used the results to decide what to build next. Product thinking. You've found the business need behind a feature request, and planned the technical work to meet it. Financial services. You've worked on lending, payments or pricing systems. The salary We expect to pay from £60,000 to £85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. description: Senior Backend Engineer - Credit Card Payments Hybrid in London, United Kingdom We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Payments Infrastructure team. The card is a core part of iwoca’s long-term growth. The Payments infrastructure team builds iwoca’s card payments platform. Its job is to approve each payment in moments when a customer uses their card. The team also builds the platforms that pay out rewards as customers spend and monitor every transaction. The team is small – a principal engineer, a product manager with a background in payments, and you. It works closely with iwoca’s ledger, fraud and customer product teams. You’ll build on your payments expertise alongside the principal engineer, with scope to grow as the platform matures. Most of the challenge is technical: scaling payments within card scheme rules and the regulation iwoca has to meet. Your code will run every time a small business uses its iwoca card. Live project examples: Payment authorisation. Extending the service built to approve or decline each card payment in real time, using data held in other services. It places a hold on available credit in the ledger and applies iwoca's own checks, such as account status, merchant category code restrictions, and spend limits. Transaction monitoring. Building the service that will screen card transactions for fraud and financial-crime risk as customers spend, so iwoca will rely less on third parties. Rewards. Extending the service that pays out cashback, as the team adds to what the card offers. Testing for failure. Designing sandbox tests that cover edge cases and failures across the card transaction lifecycle. Ledger cutover and go-live. Moving the card platform onto iwoca's own ledger and infrastructure with as little downtime as possible, then fixing the issues that only show up in production. The requirements Essential: Payment systems. You've designed and run highly available, low-latency payment systems in production, ideally on the issuing side. Card payment flows. Distributed systems. You've built microservices, REST APIs, and asynchronous messaging with queues or topics, and designed the database schemas behind them, ideally in PostgreSQL. AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone, at work or in your own projects. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience. Bonus: Ledgers and clearing. title: Director of Product Design
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and help us build the next version of Carwow. Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll be a key partner in shaping our product vision and turning it into a great experience for both customers and dealers. Carwow is a two-sided marketplace. We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars. We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses. That’s the challenge we want this person to help us solve. WHAT YOU'LL DO Shape the experience with us: Work closely with the VP of Product and our Product and Engineering leaders to define what the Carwow experience should become over the next few years. Design for both sides of our marketplace: Make sure we deeply understand both customers and dealers. Look for opportunities where making one side of the marketplace better also makes the other stronger. Connect the experience: We have great products, but they don’t always feel like one product. You’ll help us connect discovery, buying and selling across web and app, while doing the same for the dealer experience. Raise the bar for design: Help us make simpler, more useful and better-designed products. Set a high standard, but stay close enough to the work to help teams reach it. Build a great design team: Lead, coach and develop our Product Designers. Hire brilliant people when we need to and create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers. Stay close to the problem: This isn’t a role for someone who wants to manage design from a distance. We want you talking to customers and dealers, reviewing work, challenging thinking and getting involved in our hardest product problems. Use data and experimentation: Work with Product and Analytics to understand how our designs perform, test our assumptions and use what we learn to make the experience better. Explore what AI makes possible: AI is changing both the products we build and how we build them. We want someone who has used AI in real products and, more importantly, has good judgement about where it genuinely improves the experience and where it doesn’t. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We’re looking for someone who has led Product Design in a strong digital product business and still loves the work itself. You’ll have strong product judgement, care deeply about craft and know how to make complicated things feel simple. You’ll have experience designing for a marketplace, platform or similarly complex product with very different types of users. You’ll understand that designing for consumers and designing tools that professionals use every day are different challenges, and be comfortable balancing the needs of both. You’ll also need to be a great partner to Product and Engineering — able to challenge, listen, bring people together and make the product better. Automotive experience isn’t important. We’d much rather find someone who brings a fresh perspective and has helped build products people genuinely love using. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE A year from now, we should be able to see and feel the difference. We should have a clear, shared vision for the Carwow experience across customers and dealers, with meaningful progress towards making it real. Our customer and dealer experiences should feel more connected, and we should be able to point to measurable improvements in the experiences and outcomes that matter most. The quality and consistency of our design should be noticeably higher, with a stronger design team doing some of the best work of their careers. Most importantly, we should be closer to building a Carwow that customers want to come back to whenever they change their car, and that dealers wouldn’t want to run their business without. title: Product Manager
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE Buying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual. For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less. This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. If you want to own an operational product area end to end, work with some of the most sophisticated buyers in UK retail, and build things that have a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Product Strategy & Execution: Own the product direction for Carwow's dealer-facing product, defining what we build, in what order, and why Lead discovery work with dealers, interviews, on-site visits, data analysis to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into dealer workflows: smarter recommendations, vehicle pricing, performance insights that actually change behaviour Collaborate with Tech Lead, Designer, and Engineers to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics Manage the backlog with commercial awareness prioritising work that drives engagement, retention, and revenue, not just activity Partner Engagement & Insight: Build relationships with key dealer partners and use those relationships to validate product direction before we build Work with Account Management and Sales to understand what's driving churn, what's blocking adoption, and what would make carwow stickier Translate qualitative partner feedback into structured product insight; don't just collect opinions, turn them into decisions Cross-functional Leadership: Work across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal Support the commercial team on partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 1.5+ years of product management experience in a B2B or SaaS environment, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox Genuine curiosity about AI, you follow what's happening, you have a point of view on where it adds real value, and you're eager to experiment Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve Strong stakeholder instincts, you can build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, and senior stakeholders without losing your own point of view Clear written and verbal communication; title: VP of Marketing
description: Get to know us Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours. Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR) : Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions. Ideals Board : Board and leadership collaboration platform for faster, safer, and more compliant decision-making. The role Ideals is uniquely positioned to redefine the VDR industry. Now we aim to own the upmarket M&A segment and establish Ideals as the Tier 1 brand in that space - translating market leadership into stronger brand equity, pipeline, and revenue. We're looking for a VP of Marketing to make this happen. You'll lead a high-performing global team and shape the marketing function end-to-end: positioning and category authority, a scalable demand engine, and the operating system behind it. This is a builder's role for a strategic, data-driven leader who wants their work to show up in commercial results, not just in brand tracking. This is a fully remote role for candidates based in the UK , Ireland, Switzerland, or the Netherlands. What you will do Define how Ideals wins You'll own positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, and GTM plans across every product, segment, and region – the strategic foundation everything else in marketing builds on. Build category authority From industry events, reports, and benchmarks to media relations, executive visibility, and speaking programmes - you'll make Ideals the name the upmarket M&A segment thinks of first, and keep every external touchpoint aligned with our brand positioning. Turn attention into pipeline You'll drive demand generation across paid and organic channels, ABM, content, and nurture, then guide the team capturing it through search, review platforms, intent data, and conversion optimisation. As the Key Accounts Sales team scales, you'll direct regional programmes into each market's sales plan and own the result end to end against pipeline and revenue targets. Run marketing as a system You'll own the martech and analytics stack, attribution, KPI framework, and ROI reporting – plus the marketing budget, agencies, and strategic vendors – so every decision is data-driven, and every dollar is accountable. Lead the people who make it happen You'll hire, develop, and lead a global team, and work shoulder to shoulder with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to drive cohesive business growth. What you bring 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a strong SaaS background 4+ years in a senior marketing leadership role within a fast-growing company, with responsibility for the broader marketing function Proven experience leading and scaling diverse high-performing marketing teams, including hiring, talent development, and performance management Brand marketing portfolio with proven activation expertise across diverse channels and markets Hands-on experience across content, design, and growth initiatives, with the ability to go deep when needed Track record scaling digital and field marketing programs that measurably grew pipeline and revenue Solid understanding of demand generation and ABM initiatives Successful track record of implementing marketing initiatives based on analytical and data-driven decisions Excellent communication and problem-solving skills with a can-do attitude Fluency in English (C1+ level) Nice to have Experience in M&A, Investment Banking, or Financial Services, with a strong understanding of the dealmaking ecosystem What we offer We highly value our people, so we will empower you with all the resources and support to help you reach your full potential. For your best work Remote-first flexibility to shape your ideal workday Home workplace budget Co-working expense coverage Individual IT budget for extra equipment Top-tier tech and AI-powered tools For your growth Access to Ideals Academy with numerous courses Investment in external learning and development activities Guidance in Personal Development Plan creation Professional literature and subscriptions coverage Support of your passion as a speaker or writer Internal talent mobility opportunities For your well-being Tailored Wellness Package for your physical and mental health Funding for sports competitions Paid health-related time-off 25 business days of annual leave Nest Pensions scheme contribution Extra perks Budget for meetups with your local team Generous internal referral program Our culture Commitment, Excellence, Collaboration, Trust and Care are core values to the Ideals team. description: We're always keen to hear from talented sales professionals. This is not a current vacancy, but if you'd like to be considered for future opportunities at Bitwarden, register your interest and we'll contact you if a suitable role opens. Our password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey solutions make it easy for everyone to extend robust security across their devices. Bitwarden is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California, with a team located across the globe. What our Account Executives do Own a territory and an assigned quota, closing new business with a focus on organisations of 1,000+ employees Prospect effectively and manage lead flow to build a strong pipeline (typically 3–5x coverage) Manage and forecast the pipeline accurately in our CRM Build territory plans that deliver both short-term and long-term revenue Recruit, onboard and grow channel partners, including resellers, MSPs, VARs and integrators, and build joint business plans with measurable goals Work closely with marketing on events, programmes and campaigns that create demand among partners' customers Keep sales leadership informed on channel pipeline and forecast Who we'd love to hear from 4–8 years of SaaS sales experience in new business or business development. Cyber security experience is a plus but not essential A consistent track record of hitting annual quota, with specific customer wins you can talk about Proven success driving revenue through partners, with strong existing relationships with resellers, MSPs, VARs or integrators The ability to build relationships and influence decision makers at every level of a partner or customer organisation Experience at a startup or high-growth company is desirable A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and can work independently or as part of a team Excellent communication skills: listening, writing and presenting Confident with CRM tools, Google Workspace and Microsoft Office A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience Additional languages are welcome, as some territories may require them What happens next Submit your CV along with a short note telling us where you're based and the type of territory or role you're interested in. If a suitable Account Executive role opens, our Talent Acquisition team will contact you. Our process typically includes a screening call, interviews with sales leadership and the team, and a role play. A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world's largest organisations. title: Enforcement Appeals Specialist
description: Introduction to Role & Team Bumble Inc. is looking for an Enforcement Appeals Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on candidate who thrives in a cross-functional environment and is excited to support the evolution of our Trust Operations team. In this position, you will investigate and respond to members' appeals as a result of account restrictions and content moderation. You will help uphold Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines by reviewing and enforcing actions on violating accounts and content to maintain a safe and respectful environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with sensitive content, including child exploitation, graphic or physical sexual violence, suicide and self-harm, and other potentially distressing material. Trust and safety are embedded in Bumble Inc.’s mission of creating a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable. Our wider Trust organization includes centralized and dedicated teams focused on: Creating products and systems that proactively detect and prevent harm and promote healthy, kind relationships. title: Founding UI/UX Artist, Unannounced Game
description: This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social. As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions. We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey! Side quest: Read this new page about making new games at Supercell. What You'll Be Doing UX flow design for entire game experience Creation and implementation of UI screens, assets and animations Involved in pioneering a modern workflow and optimise assets for performance Discover and manage external partners where needed What You Have 5+ years of experience shipping UI/UX design for apps/games Portfolio showcasing end-to-end UI/UX work on game projects, with examples of UI and UX flows Proven ability to translate game design requirements into intuitive and visually stunning UI solutions Experience collaborating closely with engineers, game designers and artists Passionate about both UI & UX design Range of 2D Art skills (UI elements, illustrations, animations, etc.) Proficient understanding of Graphic Design and Typography A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge. Would Be Nice if You Also Have At the forefront with AI tools and actively experimenting Enjoys TCGs Where You'll Be This opportunity is based in our London office, and because we value a collaborative work environment and genuine human interactions, it is mostly an office‑based role. Supercell New Games This is a dedicated environment for building from zero and shaped around a core belief: the best developers don’t need more direction, they need more freedom and fewer barriers. This is where games get the space they need to become cultural phenomenons. Players are waiting for your vision and ambition to build the next forever game a.k.a. the best work of your career. We back this up with creative and operational autonomy, and the infrastructure, capital, and experience needed to take a game from an idea to global scale. This is not for everyone. Building towards a billion-dollar game is going to be hard. But let's not kid ourselves: it should also be fun. You build the rocket. We bring the launchpad. Game-changing Financial Model Supercell is great with stuff around benefits and wellbeing, but most importantly you get to focus on what matters: making games. Skip the Venture Capital pitch decks and looking at runway spreadsheets. In exchange, we're offering a compensation model that makes this opportunity financially life-changing. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever. So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings , and killing lots of projects. Relocation? Yes! title: Senior Director Global, BI Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit  <a href="../5377643008/wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.</p> <p>Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built OpenDoor for Amazon.</p> <p>OpenDoor is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive impact – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own 16 Leadership Principles, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p><strong>Sr. Director, Business Intelligence</strong></p> <p>In this high-profile and important role, you’ll be asked to take accountability for data and reporting solutions we develop and maintain for one of our most important clients. </p> <p>Leading a globally distributed team of technical reporting data specialists, you will be asked to design, implement, and deliver reporting and data provisioning solutions for digital and traditional media. You will be the voice of Amazon reporting and data needs within DTA, WPP’s Data, Technology and Analytics arm, borrowing from and contributing to the Amazon specific data provisioning and reporting product, structuring team staff and processes. You will be the expert clients go to when reporting and business intelligence requirements emerge or evolve. Most importantly, you must have the technical ability / agility to customize to ensure client and media teams get access to the right data and insights to make the most of our client’s media investments, and in turn ensure high client satisfaction. </p> <p>Reporting into DTA SVP for Global Reporting Services and the OpenDoor Global DTA Lead, you’ll also be asked to represent the needs of and solutions developed for the client in wider reporting initiatives, and influence the product vision and strategy within this space.</p> <ul> <li>Own reports and data provisioning solutions for the client, taking direct accountability for the quality of the team’s solutions, representing them to clients and working with media leadership to drive successful adoption</li> <li>Demonstrate firsthand understanding of client and media team needs, and lead Business Analysts in the translation of expressed needs into clear and structured requirements for engineers and BI developers</li> <li>Work with clients and media leadership to establish consensus on the prioritization of requirements for development, using your knowledge of requirements and the technical solution to steer the conversation</li> <li>Lead the design of technical solutions to meet requirements, including the scoping and estimation of work to develop</li> <li>Provide strategic coordination across disciplines on the Amazon account (Media, Measurement/Analytics, Data Excellence, Leadership)</li> <li>Hire, train, and mentor a team of data engineers and reporting specialists, ensuring they have the environment to deliver their best work</li> <li>Provide hands-on leadership, leaning in to support the team when needed, and driving continual improvement in the way we ingest, store, transform and visualize data</li> <li>Partner with Data Excellence, and Engineering as well as Measurement, Analytics and Investment leadership to ensure reporting solutions are incorporating best practice metrics to assess performance, which in turn link to client business goals</li> <li>Be the voice of the client within DTA reporting product and service steering groups, directly influencing the ongoing development of supporting data & technology infrastructure</li> <li>Provide support and training to users of reporting solutions, with the aim of empowering them to be more self-sufficient in overcoming these issues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience as a business intelligence or reporting specialists, preferably at a media agency or related company (e.g. publisher, ad tech, client marketing org)</li> <li>Experience designing and developing intuitive data visualizations with business intelligence software (e.g. PowerBi, Tableau, Looker, Datastudio) that empower end users</li> <li>Strong knowledge of using data infrastructure and cloud data management technologies, as well as data prep and ETL processes, to deliver robust data infrastructure</li> <li>Experience with digital marketing platforms and the data they generate, in particular Google Marketing Platform, Facebook, Twitter etc. Knowledge of their API’s a plus.</li> <li>Experience with WPP Media’s DPAM process and OMS, with particular benefit coming from experience with Campaign Management (formerly Olive) and Campaign Governance (formerly OCTRA)</li> <li>Experience helping set clear strategy, designing technical solutions, proactively managing feature roadmaps, and organizing technical resources to deliver it</li> <li>Excellent and adaptable written and verbal communications style, being able to translate non-technical use cases into technical requirements</li> <li>Strong influencing skills, able to represent and defend your data solutions with senior clients</li> <li>An ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, and directly influence others to drive adoption of solutions and overcome upstream barriers to implementation</li> <li>Experience leading, nurturing and coaching high-performing technical resources</li> <li>A passion for data excellence and integrity, and a commitment to supporting others and providing better solutions to support it.</li> </ul> <p>Desirable</p> <ul> <li>Specific experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), in particular S3, RedShift, and DBT.</li> <li>A general understanding of how data is tracked and exchanged in the process of digital advertising (e.g. role of adservers and other third-party providers of campaign health performance metrics such as DoubleVerify)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p> </p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. </p> <p>

title: Director, Planning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p></p> <p><strong>2020 - Director, Planning</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>Wavemaker positively provokes growth for clients by reshaping consumer decision-making and experiences through media, content, and technology. Our name is both our mission and our method. We do our best work for brave brands and people who relish being challenged to go further and faster, together.</p> <p>The planning team are the guardians of creating industry leading, unrivalled work at Wavemaker. We are central conduits to all specialists, striving to push boundaries and have a positive impact on consumers and brand.</p> <p> </p> <p>Wavemaker UK is looking for a <strong>Planning Director</strong> to join our growing planning team, to drive planning across specific clients and be a media planning expert.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Media planning craft:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop an advanced understanding of media channels, channel ecosystems and planning best practices.</li> <li>Start to translate strategic approach into planning practices for specific client briefs and pitches.</li> <li>Have an advanced understanding of Wavemakers’s Purchase Journey thinking and planning philosophy across all client work. Including being an expert in a broad set of internal tools, as well as external tools to build a deep understanding of the consumer, the client’s business and its specific opportunities.</li> <li>Have an expert overview of the media market landscape, trends and start to build media owner relationships.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Campaign management & effective communication:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee campaign management, ensuring quality control and output is of the highest standard.</li> <li>Develop a skilled understand of commercial practises and of the wider agency.</li> <li>Build and maintain client and agency relationships at a mid-senior level, to ensure a comprehensive understanding of stakeholders and client business.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Comms planning and storytelling: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Own planning presentations including defining the inputs needed and working with the wider teams to compile work and meet deadlines.</li> <li>Lead brainstorm and idea creation for campaigns</li> <li>Start to independently problem solve, including integrating and questioning data and insights and find solutions based on knowledge and experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p> </p> <p> <strong>Practice Area Knowledge -Skilled-</strong> Develops breadth and depth of industry understanding. Becomes confident using tools, technology, techniques and systems and is able to train others.</p> <p>Comfortable presenting both direct from platform (OS, Architect etc) and developing a story from data but delivered outside of platform (Telmar etc).</p> <p>Can confidently answer client questions and liaise with internal teams on best solutions to use.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Problem Solving – Skilled</strong> - Uses critical questioning and maintains a broad perspective when analyzing information to gain a deeper understanding of the problem and wider impact. Quickly generates appropriate solutions informed by previous experience. Understands how to resolve escalated issues and supports others to problem solve. Supports or leads troubleshooting communication for issues.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Stakeholder Relationships – Skilled</strong> - Has an expert knowledge of client and agency structures. Can identify key decision makers and understands their perspectives which is used to build relationships. Has strong knowledge of the client sector/industry which is shared to build strategies and plans. Identifies strategic issues and raises questions to help stakeholders explore and understand their wider business challenges. ​​​​​​​ Can easily suggest business solutions to match client/stakeholder needs and achieve objectives.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Effective Communication -Advanced-</strong> Leads the delivery of relevant and accurate information to drive maximum impact. Consistently delivers communications to influence and educate all levels of seniority, appropriately judging the demands of the situation. Creatively develops presentations and comms to help with the understanding/education of complex information. Guides others on the best practices and approaches for creating clear, concise and organized communication materials to convey plans in a user-friendly way.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Campaign Management – Advanced -</strong> Reviews the work of others to ensure accuracy and thoroughness objectives have been met; provides coaching on ways to improve work outputs.  Applies best practice to campaign management and acts as the escalation point for issues.  Provide actionable insights during mid and post campaign reports to improve in-flight optimizations and future campaign brief recommendations.  Oversees team members to discuss current projects, workload and activities prioritises resources accordingly.  Improves workload management by supporting other in setting priorities and by postponing less relevant work.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compelling Storytelling – Skilled -</strong> Applies big picture thinking in work and proactively leverages an understanding of the organization and key industry trends.  Understand the different elements of responses.  Designs differentiated communications (content focus, style, presentation etc) for various internal and external audiences.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Ideas Creation – Advanced -</strong> Lead new projects/activities that can create ideas to deliver effective solutions to clients business objectives.  Ability to proactively generate ideas to provoke and deliver against broader business strategies.  Coaches other to gain new insights and view opportunities from different perspectives.  Championing an environment that fosters innovation by encouraging others to openly share and build on other’s new ideas, products and solutions</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Comms Planning – Skilled -</strong> Applies knowledge of client, audience, channel, market and category to effectively deliver compelling multi-media plans.  Translates learnings and trends to create marketing communication strategies that are effective with clear measurement.   Application of purchase journey thinking and visualization of how the media plan works channels.  Translation of strategic direction/platform/provocation into directional role for media, channel role and behaviour in channel.  Identifies and recommends budget shifts as campaign is in-flight where appropriate.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. title: Revenue Operations Engineer
description: As a Revenue Operations Engineer at vCluster Labs, you aren't just keeping the CRM tidy; you are building the automated engine that tells our sellers which accounts matter and why. You will design Clay pipelines, enrichment workflows, and AI agents that surface the right accounts to sales and SDRs, and you will make sure they keep working long after launch. You own the GTM stack for our EMEA team, from Salesforce workflows to the integrations that tie HubSpot, Notion, and Slack together. As a Revenue Operations Engineer, your role will include: Account intelligence and enrichment: You will build and extend Clay tables, enrichment, and discovery pipelines that find new accounts and surface the right ones to sales and SDRs. You will push the tool well past its current setup and get the full value out of it. AI agents and automation: You will turn manual GTM workflows into automated ones using agents in Clay, Salesforce, and Claude. You build them to run end to end and stay useful, not to demo once and break a month later. Data quality that stays clean: You will design repeatable processes that keep account and contact data accurate over time. When a cleanup happens, it happens once, and the workflow behind it prevents the mess from coming back. Scoring and top-of-funnel signals: You will own account and MQL funnel scoring and the signal workflows that route intent to the right seller at the right time. Systems and integrations: You will build Salesforce workflows and maintain integrations across Salesforce, HubSpot, Momentum, Chili Piper, Notion, and Slack. When a new tool or feature beats what we built six months ago, you will make the call to replace it. EMEA RevOps support: You will own the RevOps ticket queue during EMEA hours, partnering with our US-based RevOps teammate for follow-the-sun coverage. That includes helping reps with live opportunity questions, not only systems work. This role could be a fit for you if you bring: Hands-on Clay experience: You have built Clay tables, enrichment waterfalls, and pipelines yourself, and can explain what you would build next. Salesforce depth: You can build Salesforce flows and automation, not just run reports. HubSpot fluency is expected alongside it. AI-forward building: You have built AI agents or automations that run in production, using tools like Claude, Clay agents, or Salesforce automation, and you can show what they do today. Systems thinking for GTM: You understand how scoring, routing, enrichment, and CRM hygiene connect, and you design for the whole loop rather than one fix. EMEA-based and self-directed: You are based in EMEA, comfortable owning a queue without a teammate in your time zone, and you decide what to fix next without waiting to be told. Bonus points for: Salesforce Admin certification: Or equivalent admin-level experience owning an org. Code and CLI comfort: Experience with scripting, APIs, the Claude CLI, or MCP integrations. Startup scaling experience: You have helped a company grow from Series A toward later stage and built the systems that growth needed. Advanced Clay or Anthropic tooling: You are the person others ask when they want to know what Clay or Claude can actually do. About vCluster Labs We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture. We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software. We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems. title: Property Manager
description: About Letly Letly is the AI-Native operating company built for the home. We believe the home should be autonomously run and we're building the software that will run all rental properties end-to-end. Our landlords hand us their most valuable asset, often on a guaranteed rent, so how well a property is run is our product. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Competency-based interview(s) focused on coordination, communication and judgement (45 mins) ecruiter screen (30 mins) Deep Dive interview with some of the team looking more closely at experience and team fit. (45 mins) Final interview (30 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
